depiction.composition: two opposing hand shapes arranged diagonally, upper-left thumb up and lower-right thumb down

readings.meaning: feedback, rating, or review (like and dislike)

ambiguity: Because the fists are simplified to geometric trapezoids without fingers or cuffs, at small sizes the pair strongly resembles opening and closing quotation marks or two tiny speech bubbles.
